st: Population decline, surrogate wombs and Grimes

sec.t: ff.29.1 We're not having kids any more
sec.p: Apparently, even though in some parts of the world the population is booming (remember 🎼 ff.13 Populations and pollutions?), Elon Musk is extremely worried because people aren't having children.

sec.t: ff.29.2 Being a mum is a job!
sec.p: A crucial issue around motherhood is its cost. In an ever more individualistic, capitalist, profit-driven world, even motherhood gets quantified.

sec.t: ff.29.3 Elon Musk's girlfriend proposes paying mums
sec.p: Elon Musk's ex-girlfriend (mother of the infamous human being X Æ A-Xii, a name as unique as it is rare) also spoke out on the issue. She proposed a MaternityDAO, i.e. a Decentralized Autonomous Organization to give credit to mums all over the world.

In a sense, though, the market has already started “compensating” motherhood: in surrogacy cases (I hate the Italian term “rented womb”, to be honest), the surrogate mother providing the service is handsomely paid by a biologically infertile mother.
